data.content:
>Finsternisse)

  1. Eclipse

  2. Darkness

    • Synonyms: Dunkelheit, Nacht

    • Antonyms: Helligkeit, Licht, Tag

We haven't found any proves of such etymology, fairies seem hyped about it, but to us it makes perfect sense for the origins of this word, where fin meaning an end while Stern (m.) means a star 🌟 in german and thus what a perfect word it becomes for describing darkness as:

Stars' End
